title: Align quest agents --check with DEC-238 (a6): override, coverage and reachability lines, byte-for-byte with the lore-cli LCLI-765 wording
description:
Follow-up to QCLI-531, from DEC-238 (a6), opum-doc ruling 2026-10-25T13:19:22Z (record: opum-ai/opum-doc PR on chore/dec-238-a6), relayed by the lead. QCLI-531 landed (#678) before (a6) arrived and shipped `stateScope: "managed-block"`, which is NOT the (a6) wording.

(a6) requires quest to adopt the SAME wording lore-cli is building for LCLI-765, so QCLI-371/381 byte-for-byte agreement holds:
1. The remedy names the scope where the override LIVES (`--scope local` for .claude/settings.local.json, `project` for .claude/settings.json, `user` for a user-scope disable), never a fixed scope. [Implemented on the branch; proved by test and mutation.]
2. `plugin-claude-override <file> (<scope> scope) sets opum-quest@opum to disabled, and wins over the user-scope row`, plus an additive JSON field. [Exact bytes to be agreed with lore-cli.]
3. `agents-coverage up-to-date covers the managed block and the skill file only, not plugin enablement`. [Exact quest phrasing to be agreed: quest state word is `current`, not `up-to-date`.]
4. `agents-skill-reachability ...`, where it applies to quest: no quest skill is expected by design under DEC-238 (a3) and DEC-172 (4bf), which differs from lore reaching no skill at all.

`stateScope: "managed-block"` (shipped in #678) stays only if (a6) lines are added beside it; if the coverage line carries the same statement, removing `stateScope` is part of this work. That call is settled with lore-cli in the same exchange.

COORDINATION: lore-cli (LCLI-765) owns the same lines for opum-lore@opum; one PR per repository. Bytes must be identical modulo the plugin id and any quest-specific vocabulary lore-cli and opum-doc agree. Nothing is invented here: an unconfirmed string that lands becomes the contract.

RELEASE/MERGE: this PR does NOT merge on green. The next leader spawns a reviewer unit and clears the merge. No release.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The remedy prints the scope where the override lives (local, project, or user) and never a fixed scope; proved by a test that fails when the listing row scope is used instead
The plugin-claude-override line and its additive JSON field carry bytes agreed verbatim with lore-cli (LCLI-765), with only the plugin id and any agreed quest vocabulary differing
The agents-coverage line is present with the agreed bytes, and stateScope is either removed or kept beside it per the agreement recorded on this task
The agents-skill-reachability line is present with the agreed bytes for quest, or its omission is recorded with the reason lore-cli and opum-doc gave
The exit code is unchanged by any of these lines (DEC-238 (a5))
The agreed bytes and the exchange that fixed them are recorded on this task before the PR is offered for review

definitionOfDone.text: The PR is opened and left unmerged for a reviewer unit; no release
Tests pin each line and the remedy scope, and a mutation turns the relevant test red
The full repository check exits 0 on the PR head
